description_for_human: Charter school IT helpdesk API for device lookups, staff account status, and ticket management.
description_for_model: Use this API to help charter school staff with IT issues. Call getDevices to look up device status by serial number or staff name. Call getUsers to check account status, license, and last login. Call getTickets to list open tickets. Call createTicket to submit a new IT support ticket on behalf of a staff member.

functions.name: createTicket
functions.description: Creates a new helpdesk ticket for an IT issue reported by staff. Call this whenever a staff member reports an unresolved issue, with staff_name, issue_category, and description as query parameters.

functions.name: getDevices
functions.description: Returns device information. Filter by serial number or assigned user.

functions.name: getTickets
functions.description: Returns open or recent IT tickets. Filter by status or staff name.

functions.name: getUsers
functions.description: Returns account status, license info, and last login for a staff member.
